_about: bangladesh-research-institutes «বাংলাদেশের গবেষণা প্রতিষ্ঠান» (work in progress, RES-2, 2026-10-09). The national research institutes whose main work, by their own page, is research, one point each at its head office, in four tabs. Every fact cites a page pinned in sources.json by { source, offset, length, sha256 } into its text after Unicode NFC normalisation (no words are kept); points are in pins.json. null = unverified (pending); absent = not applicable. Decisions: notes/bangladesh-research-institutes.md.
